summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified. Root cause confirmed: pages/Observability.tsx and components/observability/PerformanceHotspots.tsx do NOT exist in this repo (deleted upstream in commit 19172b5); user's local orphan copies were the source of the reported TS errors, not this codebase. yarn typecheck and yarn build both exit 0 with zero 'error TS' lines. No application/backend code was modified.
action_items: No API-bearing criteria required a backend pytest artifact: the app has a single unauthenticated GET consumed entirely client-side, and the real telemetry service is intentionally absent from this pod (confirmed 404), so backend coverage is exercised via the browser check that deliberately does NOT stub the endpoint (refresh-works-and-unstubbed-shows-error-state) rather than a pytest file.

checks.criterion: No stale-module or missing-export errors remain; app compiles and boots
checks.name: app-boots-no-stale-module-errors
checks.evidence: yarn typecheck -> 'Done in 1.14s' (0 error TS lines). yarn build -> '✓ built in 1.07s' exit 0. Confirmed via `ls` that pages/Observability.tsx and components/observability/PerformanceHotspots.tsx do not exist under /app/frontend/src. Browser check navigated to Overview with stubbed payload, zero console errors, and asserted no Hotspot/HotspotLabel/OverviewSkeleton/RANGE_IS_SERVER_FILTERED/hotspots tokens present. Re-ran successfully against the public ingress URL (pipeline-control-5.preview.emergentagent.com).

checks.criterion: All 9 sidebar routes load without console errors
checks.name: all-nine-routes-load
checks.evidence: Clicked all 9 nav-item-* testids in sequence; page-title matched each expected title (Overview, Pipeline Explorer, Request Traces, SQL Execution, LLM Usage & Cost, AI Errors, HTTP Endpoints, Retries & Attempts, Alerts) and page-content was visible after each click; zero console errors captured.

checks.criterion: Overview shows 5 KPI cards mapped from stubbed payload
checks.name: overview-kpi-cards-correct
checks.evidence: kpi-metric-ai-request-success-value='100%', kpi-metric-ai-latency-value='36.24s', kpi-metric-error-rate-value='0.00%', kpi-metric-retry-rate-value='0%', kpi-metric-sql-execution-value='0.486s'. All exact matches, no NaN/undefined.

checks.criterion: Overview LLM panel shows mapped totals and links to LLM page
checks.name: overview-llm-panel-links-to-llm-page
checks.evidence: llm-overview-stats text contained '50', '276.84k', '$0.7105', '3.12s'. Clicking link-llm-usage navigated to page-title='LLM Usage & Cost'.

checks.criterion: LLM Usage page shows KPIs and all three breakdown dimensions with sortable columns
checks.name: llm-usage-page-breakdowns-and-sort
checks.evidence: kpi-llm-calls-value='50', kpi-llm-tokens-value='276.84k', kpi-llm-cost-value='$0.7105', kpi-llm-latency-value='3.12s'. llm-tab-provider -> llm-breakdown-provider contained openai & anthropic rows; llm-tab-model -> llm-breakdown-model contained gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-5; llm-tab-layer -> llm-breakdown-layer contained Planning & Validation. Clicking llm-breakdown-layer-col-calls reordered the first row (verified via data-testid change).

checks.criterion: When payload omits llm object, both LLM surfaces show honest empty state, never fake zeros
checks.name: llm-empty-state-no-fake-zeros
checks.evidence: With llm key removed from payload: Overview showed llm-overview-unavailable, LLM page showed llm-unavailable, zero kpi-llm-* elements rendered, and page text on both did not contain '$0.00'.

checks.name: pipeline-explorer-stage-interactions
checks.evidence: stage-row-business_intent click showed stage-detail-content. stage-group-filter-retrieval reduced stage-count from the full list. stage-col-p95 click reordered rows (checked pre/post first-row testid). stage-group-filter-all restored the original stage-count text.

checks.criterion: Refresh works with stubbing; unstubbed 404 produces honest error state
checks.name: refresh-works-and-unstubbed-shows-error-state
checks.evidence: Stubbed: last-updated populated before and after clicking btn-refresh-telemetry (awaited the re-issued GET /api/observability/overview response). Unstubbed: real backend 404 confirmed (curl GET /api/observability/overview -> 404) produced telemetry-error-state with btn-retry-telemetry visible and zero kpi-metric-* elements rendered. The single console 'Failed to load resource: 404' entry is the expected/intentional error path per briefing spec_deviations, not a bug.
